title: 20-Minute Kettlebell Finisher (No Rest, Sorry)

description:

sentences.t: And that's time, put the bell down, put it down, you're done.
Oh my gosh.
Okay, walk it out, don't just collapse on the floor, keep your legs moving for a minute.
That was five rounds of swings, goblet squats, and single arm presses, and I'm not going to lie, round four got me.
If you kept the same bell the whole way through, I'm genuinely proud of you.
If you had to drop down a size halfway, that is also completely fine, that's literally how you're supposed to scale this.
Let's talk about form for a second while we breathe, because I watched a lot of your clips from last week's challenge.
The biggest thing I saw on swings was people squatting the bell up instead of hinging.
The swing is a hip snap, it is not a front raise, your arms are basically ropes.
If your shoulders are burning more than your glutes, that's the sign.
On the goblet squats, keep that bell glued to your chest and let your elbows track inside your knees.
And on the presses, squeeze the opposite fist, it sounds weird, but it locks your whole side down and you'll press more.
Okay, let's get into a quick stretch, hip flexors first.
Drop into a half kneeling position, tuck your tailbone under, and just lean forward a little.
You should feel that right at the front of the hip, not in your lower back.
Hold that for thirty seconds and then switch sides.
Now a figure four on your back, ankle over the opposite knee, and pull that leg in gently.
This one is for your glutes, which, after fifty swings, are probably filing a complaint right now.
Now a child's pose, arms long, and just let your breathing slow down.
In through the nose, long breath out through the mouth, and let your heart rate come all the way back down.
I do this finisher twice a week on top of my normal lifting, and it has done more for my conditioning than any amount of jogging ever did.
And I hate jogging, so that's a win on two fronts.
If you want the full eight week program this is from, it's on the channel as a playlist, totally free.
Comment your bell weight below so we can all keep each other honest.
That's it for today, thank you so much for sweating with me, and I'll see you Thursday for lower body.
Bye, guys!
